The '''Rotoksa Mountain Range''' was a snowy [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range located on the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]]. The mountains contained the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ridgetown]].<ref name="LoNH" />
